edge_rgb_bleed: RGB extends 2 logical pixels into clear edge texels; alpha remains zero. This is intentional filtering padding, not a background.
art_method: Individually authored vector artwork; independently rasterized for each resolution. No screenshot or sprite-sheet crops, no bitmap upscaling.
